seoTitle: MySQL Slow Query Log Analyzer: Group by Fingerprint
metaDescription: Group MySQL slow queries by pattern and rank by total time, average, max or count, with rows examined versus sent. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Groups slow log entries by fingerprint and ranks them.
why:
One slow query pattern may run thousands of times. Total time per pattern shows where the server spends its time.

For each pattern the tool shows count, total, average and maximum time, lock time and rows examined versus rows sent. Examining far more rows than returned is a sign of a missing index.
howTo: Enable the slow query log and collect it.
Paste the log or open the file.
Choose ranking by total, average, max or count.
